blocks.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) are transforming Software Defined Networking (SDN) by bringing predictive insights, automation, and adaptive capabilities. Traditional SDN relies on predefined rules and manual configurations, which can be insuicient in managing complex and dynamic networks. AI and ML enable SDN to move beyond static rules to intelligent decision-making, improving eiciency, security, and user experience.

Imagine managing a massive train network where delays, congestion, and breakdowns are common. Now, what if there’s an AI-powered system predicting train delays before they happen, optimising schedules dynamically, and ensuring seamless operations? Similarly, in SDN, AI and ML bring intelligence and adaptability to networks, transforming them into self-optimising systems. Let’s explore how AI and ML are shaping the future of SDN.
